spans.s:
नैवटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Near, being near.
 E. निकट, and ठञ् aff.

नैवि(ब)ड्य n. (-ड्यं)
 1. Thickness, substance.
 2. Closeness, compactness.
3. Continued sound.
 E. निविड thick, &c. ष्यञ् aff.

नैवेद्य n. (-द्यं) An offering of eatable articles presented to a deity, and
may afterwards be distributed to his ministers or worshippers, es-
pecially when it has been presented to any form of VIṢṆU. E.
निवेद presenting, offering, ष्यञ् aff.

नैवेशिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A present to a Brāhman who is a householder,
a girl so given, or ornaments with her, &c.
 E. निवेश a house,
aff. ठक् ।
